answer_1.quote: We define two complementary tasks: (1) Feature-centric opinion extraction (FOE) evaluates whether LLMs can accurately extract structured opinions from online content and (2) Opinion-centric insight generation (OIG) assesses whether LLMs can mine high-level topics and insights from user opinions expressed in online content.

answer_2.quote: For lexical evaluation, we adopt ROUGE-1, 10, L (Lin, 2004), which measure word overlap between the reference and generated insights. For semantic evaluation, we leverage BERTScore (BS) (Zhang et al.) and A3CU.

answer_3.quote: To ensure a systematic and comprehensive evaluation, we also conduct reference-free assessments using an LLM-as-a judge.

answer_4.quote: We assess the quality of the generated insight through a human evaluation conducted on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT).
answer_4.guideline: Each judge rates the quality of the insights on a 1 to 5 scale across six criteria.
